title: Who I Am
text: I'm an 18-year-old from the Czech Republic, currently exploring life, technology, and the open road.

title: What Drives Me
text: I enjoy riding motorcycles, diving into video games and music, reading books that make you think, and having real conversations with people who share curiosity about the world.

title: My Approach
text: Quietly building my own path — learning, observing, and trying to leave things a little better than I found them.
